example_sentences.japanese: 今日は仕事がありません。
example_sentences.hiragana: きょうはしごとがありません。
example_sentences.english: I have no work today.

example_sentences.japanese: 今日はありがとう
example_sentences.english: As for today - thank you (Thank you for today).

example_sentences.japanese: 今日も
example_sentences.english: [You go there] today, too?

notes: Common time word. Can also be read as 'asu' in formal contexts.

example_sentences.japanese: 明日、また来ます。
example_sentences.english: I'll come again tomorrow.

example_sentences.japanese: 昨日タイカレーを食べました。
example_sentences.hiragana: きのうタイカレーをたべました。
example_sentences.english: I had Thai curry yesterday.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は今、勉強しています。
example_sentences.hiragana: かれはいま、べんきょうしています。
example_sentences.romaji: kare wa ima, benkyou shite imasu.
example_sentences.english: He's studying now.

example_sentences.japanese: 今、朝ご飯を作っています。
example_sentences.hiragana: いま、あさごはんをつくっています。
example_sentences.english: I'm making breakfast now.

example_sentences.japanese: 時の経つのは早い。
example_sentences.hiragana: ときのたつのははやい。
example_sentences.romaji: toki no tatsu no wa hayai.
example_sentences.english: Time passes by quickly.

example_sentences.japanese: 仕事の後、映画を見た。
example_sentences.hiragana: しごとのあと、えいがをみた。
example_sentences.romaji: shigoto no ato, eiga wo mita.
example_sentences.english: I saw a movie after work.

example_sentences.japanese: ここにタイヤの跡があるわ。
example_sentences.english: There is a tire imprint here.

example_sentences.japanese: その店の前で会いましょう。
example_sentences.hiragana: そのみせのまえであいましょう。
example_sentences.romaji: sono mise no mae de aimashou.
example_sentences.english: Let's meet in front of the shop.

notes: Can mean 'already', 'yet', or 'another' depending on context.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼はもう帰りました。
example_sentences.hiragana: かれはもうかえりました。
example_sentences.english: He's already gone home.

example_sentences.japanese: コーヒーをもう一杯ください。
example_sentences.hiragana: コーヒーをもういっぱいください。
example_sentences.english: Please give me another cup of coffee.

example_sentences.japanese: 宿題はまだ終わっていません。
example_sentences.hiragana: しゅくだいはまだおわっていません。
example_sentences.english: I haven't finished my homework yet.

example_sentences.japanese: 宿題は未だ終わっていません。
example_sentences.english: I haven't finished my homework yet.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女はいつ来ますか。

example_sentences.english: I don't have time now.

example_sentences.japanese: これまでの私とは違うんです。

example_sentences.english: The days are long in summer.

example_sentences.japanese: 私たちは先月11日に結婚しました。
example_sentences.english: We got married last month on the 11th.

example_sentences.japanese: 父は休みの日はずっとテレビを見ている。

example_sentences.english: I just love to travel.

example_sentences.english: He responded after a short pause.

english: some time ago, a little while ago

example_sentences.japanese: 以前彼はこの町に住んでいたんだ。
example_sentences.english: He used to live in this town.

example_sentences.japanese: この際はっきり言っておきます。
example_sentences.english: It's a good opportunity to speak frankly.

example_sentences.japanese: 現在の気温は30度です。
example_sentences.english: The current temperature is 30 degrees.

example_sentences.japanese: 私たちは毎日散歩をします。
example_sentences.english: We go for a walk every day.

example_sentences.japanese: やがて雪も止むでしょう。

example_sentences.english: It took three days for the letter to arrive.

example_sentences.japanese: 走者が次々にゴールしました。
example_sentences.english: Runners reached the goal one after another.

example_sentences.japanese: 今後ともよろしくお願いします。
example_sentences.english: I look forward to working with you in the future.

example_sentences.japanese: もはや彼の助けは必要じゃないの。
example_sentences.english: His help is no longer needed.

example_sentences.japanese: 明日は暇ですか。

example_sentences.japanese: ご無事で何よりです。
example_sentences.english: I'm glad to know you're safe.

example_sentences.japanese: 僕はいつかアフリカに行きたい。
example_sentences.english: I want to go to Africa some time.

example_sentences.japanese: 今はあなたにとって大事な時期です。
example_sentences.english: It's an important time for you now.

example_sentences.japanese: 今更後悔しても、もう遅いよ。
example_sentences.english: It is too late for regrets.

example_sentences.japanese: 新しい年が始まりました。
example_sentences.english: A new year has started.

example_sentences.japanese: 明日、久しぶりに友達に会います。
example_sentences.english: Tomorrow I'm meeting a friend I haven't seen for a long time.

english: at that time, at the present time

example_sentences.japanese: 彼女は当時、まだ3才だった。
example_sentences.english: She was only three years old at the time.

example_sentences.japanese: 彼は相変わらず忙しいですね。
example_sentences.english: He is busy as usual.

example_sentences.japanese: 今年はイタリアに旅行したい。

example_sentences.japanese: 来月の一日は空いていますか。

example_sentences.japanese: 日々の努力が大切です。

example_sentences.japanese: 私は二日待った。

example_sentences.japanese: 食べた直後に寝ないほうがいいよ。
example_sentences.english: You should not sleep immediately after having eaten.

example_sentences.english: I just made it in time for the start of work.

example_sentences.japanese: 午前9時のニュースです。
example_sentences.english: And now for the 9.00 a.m. news.

example_sentences.english: The new school term starts on the fourth of next month.

example_sentences.japanese: 今夜は月がとてもきれいです。
example_sentences.english: The moon is very beautiful tonight.

example_sentences.japanese: 段々仕事が楽しくなってきました。

example_sentences.english: He got a fever just before going on holiday.

example_sentences.japanese: 昼間は仕事で忙しいです。
example_sentences.english: I'm busy with work in the daytime.

example_sentences.japanese: 晩ご飯は食べましたか。
example_sentences.english: Have you had dinner?

example_sentences.japanese: そちらに着くのは6時前後です。
example_sentences.english: I will arrive there around 6 o'clock.

example_sentences.japanese: これはとても手間のかかる料理です。
example_sentences.english: This is a very time-consuming dish.

example_sentences.japanese: 昨夜はテレビで喜劇を見たよ。
example_sentences.english: I watched a comedy show on TV last night.
